name: The Campaign
blurb: Thirty-one levels between you and the way out.

name: The Phobia Wing
blurb: Forty-four fears, one creature each. Opens once Level 0 is escaped.

name: Corruption
blurb: Thirty of the original levels, left to rot for a thousand years. Cracked floors, rifts into the pale abyss, strong currents, and things that grew too many limbs.

name: Playground
blurb: Thirty bright, loud places: waterslides where only one in four lets you live, towers of stairwells, and every ride the park ever built.
